input: Submit my novel manuscript to three literary agents

gold.taskTitle: Submit Novel Manuscript to Three Literary Agents
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to submit their completed or in-progress novel manuscript to three literary agents for representation consideration.

questions.title: What genre is your novel?
questions.description: Knowing the genre (e.g. literary fiction, thriller, fantasy, romance) determines which agents are the right fit to query.

questions.title: Is the manuscript fully written and revised?
questions.description: Understanding whether the manuscript is complete or still in progress affects the timeline and what preparation steps are needed.

questions.title: Have you written a query letter yet?
questions.description: A query letter is required for almost all agent submissions, so knowing its status determines whether drafting it is part of this plan.

questions.title: Do you have specific agents already in mind?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user has already researched and shortlisted agents, or needs to find them, shapes the research steps required.

questions.title: What is your target deadline for sending submissions?
questions.description: A concrete deadline or timeframe helps structure the plan with realistic milestones and urgency.

questions.title: Do you have a synopsis prepared for your novel?
questions.description: Many agents require a one- to two-page synopsis alongside the query letter and sample pages, so its existence matters for preparation.

questions.title: How many sample pages or chapters do you have polished?
questions.description: Agents typically request the first 5, 10, or 50 pages, so knowing how much is submission-ready affects the readiness assessment.
